questions.question: What will this Spring Security configuration allow?
questions.correctOutput: Public endpoints accessible to all, admin endpoints only to ADMIN users, others require authentication.
questions.correctAnswer: Public endpoints accessible to all, admin endpoints only to ADMIN users, others require authentication.
questions.explanation: The rules are evaluated in order; `/api/public/**` is open, `/api/admin/**` requires ADMIN, all others need authentication.

questions.question: What does this method return if the user has role 'ADMIN'?
questions.explanation: `hasRole('USER')` will return false for an ADMIN, so access is denied.

questions.question: What is the result of this cascade configuration when a User is deleted?
questions.codeSnippet:
@OneToMany(mappedBy = "user", cascade = CascadeType.ALL, orphanRemoval = true)
private List<Order> orders;
questions.correctOutput: All associated orders are also deleted.
questions.correctAnswer: All associated orders are also deleted.
questions.explanation: CascadeType.ALL propagates all operations including delete; orphanRemoval ensures removal from collection results in deletion.

questions.question: What will this validation produce for a request with an empty name?
questions.explanation: `@NotBlank` triggers validation failure, which Spring translates into MethodArgumentNotValidException.

questions.correctOutput: select u from User u where u.email = ?1
questions.correctAnswer: select u from User u where u.email = ?1

questions.question: What is the default HTTP status for a successful POST request without @ResponseStatus?
questions.explanation: If no status is specified, Spring returns 200 OK.
